name: Ennigerloh (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Ennigerloh (three white scallop shells on green).
history: Municipal flag of Ennigerloh; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ennigerloh arms — three scallop shells on green
